verdict.rationale: Mollie gives an agent the building blocks. Webhooks deliver real-time payment status updates, and next-gen webhooks add event-type subscriptions plus a Webhook Events API for checking past events. The Payments and recurring APIs let an agent create charges, Idempotency-Key makes retries safe from double charges, and Payment Links can be attached to unpaid invoices and shared by email or chat for outreach. The hosted MCP server also exposes the Payments, Payment Links, Webhooks, Webhook Events, Customers, Mandates and Subscriptions APIs to agents. However, retry scheduling and dunning outreach must be built by the agent or integrator; nothing in the evidence shows them as native features. Missing for 10: explicitly documented failed-payment event types, built-in automatic retry/smart retry logic, native dunning workflows or reminder emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
